import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000007;
    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, cost, type;
        Edge(int t, int c, int v, int ty) {
            this.to = t;
            this.cap = c;
            this.cost = v;
            this.type = ty;
        }
    }

    static List<Integer>[] adj = new ArrayList[100000];
    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[1000000];
    static int edgeIdx;
    static int sinkNode;
    static int C, d;

    static int[] dist = new int[100000];
    static int[] inQ = new int[100000];
    static int[] queue = new int[100000];
    static int[] minCost = new int[100000];

    static void resetFlow(int sink) {
        sinkNode = sink;
        for (int i = 0; i <= sink; i++) {
            adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        edgeIdx = 0;
    }

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost, int type) {
        adj[u].add(edgeIdx);
        edges[edgeIdx] = new Edge(v, cap, cost, type);
        edgeIdx++;
        adj[v].add(edgeIdx);
        if (type == 1) {
            edges[edgeIdx] = new Edge(u, 0, -C + d, type);
            edgeIdx++;
        } else {
            edges[edgeIdx] = new Edge(u, 0, -cost, type);
            edgeIdx++;
        }
    }

    static int runFlow() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= sinkNode; i++) {
            minCost[i] = INF;
            inQ[i] = 0;
        }
        minCost[sinkNode] = 0;
        int front = 0, back = 1;
        queue[0] = 0;
        while (front < back) {
            int u = queue[front++];
            inQ[u] = 0;
            for (int r : adj[u]) {
                int v = edges[r].to;
                if (edges[r].cap > 0 && minCost[u] + edges[r].cost < minCost[v]) {
                    minCost[v] = minCost[u] + edges[r].cost;
                    if (inQ[v] == 0) {
                        inQ[v] = 1;
                        queue[back++] = v;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (minCost[sinkNode] == INF) return -1;
        int cur = sinkNode;
        while (cur != 0) {
            int r = 0;
            for (int idx : adj[cur]) {
                if (edges[idx].to == cur && edges[idx ^ 1].cap > 0 && minCost[cur] == minCost[edges[idx].to] + edges[idx].cost) {
                    r = idx;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (edges[r].type == 1) {
                if ((r & 1) == 1) {
                    edges[r].cost += 2 * d;
                    edges[r ^ 1].cost -= 2 * d;
                } else {
                    edges[r].cost += 2 * d;
                    edges[r ^ 1].cost -= 2 * d;
                }
            }
            edges[r].cap--;
            edges[r ^ 1].cap++;
            cur = edges[r ^ 1].to;
        }
        return minCost[sinkNode];
    }

    static int totalFlow(int n) {
        int total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            total += runFlow();
        }
        return total;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        C = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();

        resetFlow(n * 100 + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            addEdge(0, x, 1, 0, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= 99; i++) {
            addEdge(1 + i * n, 100 * n + 1, INF, 0, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= 99; j++) {
                addEdge(i + (j - 1) * n, i + j * n, INF, C, 0);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int x = sc.nextInt();
            int y = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 1; j <= 99; j++) {
                addEdge(x + (j - 1) * n, y + j * n, INF, C + d, 1);
                addEdge(y + (j - 1) * n, x + j * n, INF, C + d, 1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(totalFlow(k));
        sc.close();
    }
}
